decision_interpretation: Use direct road vehicles from assembly zone A to destination zone D with the baseline road fleet and schedule.
claim_boundary: Decision support comparator only; outcomes depend on congestion disruption severity and fleet assumptions.
notes: Baseline direct road option for paired comparison.

decision_interpretation: Use feeder shuttles to rail access S then scheduled rail to R and last-mile road vehicles to D under baseline assumptions.
claim_boundary: Conditional multimodal comparator only; it can be robust or fragile depending on access roads rail service transfers and last-mile capacity.
notes: Baseline rail-bus option for paired comparison.

decision_interpretation: Add redundant last-mile vehicle availability after rail egress to test whether R to D road capacity is the bottleneck.
claim_boundary: Tests one bottleneck relief mechanism; it does not assume redundancy is cost effective or generally faster.
notes: Scales last-mile fleet upward while leaving feeder rail and transfer assumptions unchanged.

decision_interpretation: Space feeder departures and release last-mile vehicles on demand when rail batches arrive to reduce schedule bunching.
claim_boundary: Represents a deterministic dispatch variant only; benefits may disappear under different arrival rail or road conditions.
notes: Uses existing on-demand last-mile behavior when interval is zero.

decision_interpretation: Increase feeder shuttle fleet availability from A to S to test whether access to rail constrains multimodal performance.
claim_boundary: Only isolates feeder capacity sensitivity; it does not resolve rail transfer or last-mile bottlenecks by itself.
notes: Scales shuttle fleet upward and leaves downstream resources unchanged.

decision_interpretation: Use a road-network variant with additional direct-road corridor redundancy where such a variant has been documented.
claim_boundary: Applicable only when the network variant represents a documented corridor option; it is not a calibrated route plan.
notes: For abstract tests this maps to the matched_redundancy variant; real-world pilots need an accepted equivalent graph.

decision_interpretation: Stress multimodal reliance on rail by lengthening rail travel and headway while reducing assumed train capacity.
claim_boundary: Scenario stress test only; it does not predict actual agency service availability during emergencies.
notes: Keeps rail available but degraded to expose conditional resilience limits.

decision_interpretation: Reduce feeder and last-mile vehicle availability to test how constrained road fleets affect multimodal completion.
claim_boundary: Stress case for sensitivity analysis only; it should be compared against matched assumptions and not read as a forecast.
notes: Uses deterministic scaling with at least one vehicle retained after rounding.

decision_interpretation: Simulate peak-hour road congestion with high background traffic volume on bus-only transport.
claim_boundary: Stress test for road-only capacity under congestion; not an observed traffic forecast.
notes: Background volume multiplied by 8x to simulate peak-hour congestion on all road links; tests whether bus-only degrades under congestion.

decision_interpretation: Simulate peak-hour road congestion with high background traffic volume on multimodal transport.
claim_boundary: Tests whether rail bypass provides resilience advantage when road links are congested.
notes: Background volume multiplied by 8x on road links; rail segment is immune to road congestion; tests the conditional multimodal advantage hypothesis.

decision_interpretation: Simulate moderate road congestion on bus-only transport at 2x background volume.
claim_boundary: Intermediate congestion test for threshold identification.
notes: 2x background volume tests early congestion response for bus-only.

decision_interpretation: Simulate moderate road congestion on multimodal transport at 2x background volume.
claim_boundary: Intermediate congestion test for threshold identification.
notes: 2x background volume tests early congestion response for multimodal.

decision_interpretation: Simulate heavy road congestion on bus-only transport at 4x background volume.

notes: 4x background volume probes near the expected bus-multimodal crossover.

decision_interpretation: Simulate heavy road congestion on multimodal transport at 4x background volume.
claim_boundary: Heavy congestion test near expected threshold.
notes: 4x background volume probes near the expected bus-multimodal crossover.

decision_interpretation: Simulate severe road congestion on bus-only transport at 6x background volume.

decision_interpretation: Simulate severe road congestion on multimodal transport at 6x background volume.

decision_interpretation: Add mild transfer friction with +3 min fixed delay and +0.5 min per passenger to test whether small transfer overhead degrades multimodal completion.
claim_boundary: Sensitivity stress test only; transfer delay assumptions are unvalidated and do not predict actual station processing times.
notes: Delta adds 3 min to default 5 min fixed = 8 min fixed plus 0.5 min per passenger; tests mild transfer degradation.

decision_interpretation: Add moderate transfer friction with +6 min fixed delay and +1.0 min per passenger to expose transfer timing sensitivity under crowd loading.
claim_boundary: Sensitivity stress test only; increased per-passenger friction is an assumption proxy for crowding or accessibility delays.
notes: Delta adds 6 min to default 5 min fixed = 11 min fixed plus 1.0 min per passenger; tests moderate transfer degradation.

decision_interpretation: Add severe transfer friction with +10 min fixed delay and +2.0 min per passenger to stress multimodal reliance on efficient station transfer.
claim_boundary: Stress test for resilience bounds only; does not represent a calibrated station scenario or operational transfer plan.
notes: Delta adds 10 min to default 5 min fixed = 15 min fixed plus 2.0 min per passenger; tests severe transfer bottleneck.

decision_interpretation: Add extreme transfer friction with +15 min fixed delay and +3.0 min per passenger to test multimodal collapse under transfer bottleneck.
claim_boundary: Extreme stress test for resilience envelope only; values exceed plausible real-world transfer and represent worst-case sensitivity bounds.
notes: Delta adds 15 min to default 5 min fixed = 20 min fixed plus 3.0 min per passenger; tests extreme transfer collapse.

decision_interpretation: Severe fleet reduction at 0.50x for both feeder and last-mile to test multimodal collapse under extreme fleet constraint.
claim_boundary: Stress test for resilience bounds only; extreme shortage does not represent a calibrated operational scenario.
notes: Severe fleet shortage at 0.50x for both feeder and last-mile; tests multimodal collapse under extreme fleet constraint.

claim_boundary: Sensitivity stress test only; vehicle capacity assumptions are unvalidated.
notes: Mild last-mile capacity reduction to 35 passengers per vehicle; tests sensitivity to vehicle size.
